name: io.github.xkqg/matplotlibnet
description: Renders MatPlotLibNet charts to PNG, SVG or PDF from a JSON spec an AI agent writes.

environmentVariables.name: MATPLOTLIBNET_MCP_OUTPUT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: The only directory save_chart may write under. Defaults to the system temp directory.

environmentVariables.name: MATPLOTLIBNET_FONTS
environmentVariables.description: Font files (.ttf, .otf) and directories of them, separated by ';', registered at startup so a chart can use a script the bundled font lacks (Devanagari, Thai, Chinese). Arabic and Hebrew work without it.
